subject: english
objectives: 使用 have to 表達由規則或情況形成的義務。
依主詞與時間變化 have to，並正確形成問句與否定。

sections.title: have to 可表達客觀要求
sections.content: have to + base form 常用於校規、時刻、工作要求或情況造成的必要，例如 We have to leave before six。它和 must 都能表達義務，差別常由語境與說話者觀點決定，不宜當成毫無例外的二分。

sections.title: 第三人稱單數使用 has to
sections.content: I、you、we、they 與複數主詞使用 have to；he、she、it 與單數名詞使用 has to，例如 Ben has to take the bus。to 後的主要動詞仍用原形。

sections.title: 過去與未來義務會改變 have
sections.content: 過去義務使用 had to，例如 We had to wait yesterday；未來義務可用 will have to，例如 I will have to get up early tomorrow。不能寫 will has to 或 had to waited。

sections.title: 問句與否定使用 do 系統
sections.content: 現在式問句可用 Do you have to...? 或 Does she have to...?；否定 do not have to 表示沒有必要。因為 have to 不是單一情態助動詞，句型變化和 must 不同。

workedExamples.prompt: Sam ___ wear a school uniform. (has to / have to / has wear)
steps: 義務結構使用 has to。
workedExamples.why: Sam 是單數，因此校服規定用 has to wear。have to 不符合主詞，has wear 則缺少 have to 結構中的 to。

workedExamples.prompt: We ___ wait for an hour yesterday. (had to / have to / will have to)
steps: 過去義務使用 had to。
workedExamples.why: 等待義務發生在昨天，所以要用 had to wait。have to 是現在形式，will have to 則會把等待放到未來。

workedExamples.prompt: ___ Lily have to bring her own cup? (Does / Has / Is)
steps: have to 問句借助 Does。
Does 後保留 have 原形。
workedExamples.why: 現在式 have to 問句使用 Does Lily have to...?。Has Lily have to 疊加不合的形式，Is 也不能和 have to 建立義務問句。

misconceptions.belief: he、she 與單一人名都使用 have to。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 現在式第三人稱單數要使用 has to。
misconceptions.correction: 寫 She has to leave；複數才寫 They have to leave。

misconceptions.belief: had to 後的動詞也要改成過去式。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 過去時間已由 had 表示，to 後維持原形。
misconceptions.correction: 使用 had to wait，不寫 had to waited。

misconceptions.belief: Does she has to...? 是正確問句。
misconceptions.whyWrong: Does 後的 have 必須回到原形。
misconceptions.correction: 寫 Does she have to bring it?。

misconceptions.belief: must 與 have to 在每個句子都有完全固定的內外差別。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 兩者常重疊，實際選擇受語境、語氣與句型影響。
misconceptions.correction: 先確定是否為義務，再利用時間、主詞與原句形式選擇。

checks.prompt: Ben have to leave 中哪個字要改？
yesterday 的義務使用 have to 還是 had to？
checks.reason: had to 表示過去的必要。

checks.prompt: Does Mia has to go 應如何修正？
checks.reason: Does 後使用 have 原形。
